facts.text: Terrain and soil tools calculate ground deformation under a machine, bucket digging into a pile, and loose-material flow; soft ground changes how a machine stops.
facts.quote: Terrain and soil tools calculate how the ground deforms under a machine, how a bucket digs into a pile and how loose material flows, because soft ground changes how a machine stops.

facts.text: The Soil Contact Model (SCM) is a fast, semi-empirical method from Bekker and Wong that models deformable ground using pressure-sinkage rules.
facts.quote: The Soil Contact Model (SCM) is a fast, semi-empirical method from Bekker and Wong that treats the ground as a deformable mat with pressure-sinkage rules.

facts.text: The Discrete Element Method (DEM) simulates thousands or millions of individual grains and their collisions; DEM is realistic for piles and digging but very slow.
facts.quote: The Discrete Element Method (DEM) simulates thousands or millions of individual grains and their collisions, which is realistic for piles and digging but very slow.

facts.text: Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) and related continuum methods represent flowing soil with particles; Chrono calls its version CRM.
facts.quote: Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) and related continuum methods treat the soil as a flowing material represented by particles; Chrono calls its version CRM

facts.text: EDEM is a DEM program for bulk material such as soil, ore and coal, and couples with multibody tools.
facts.quote: EDEM, a DEM program for bulk material such as soil, ore and coal that couples with multibody tools

facts.text: Chapter 11 lists EDEM as Simcenter EDEM, while Chapter 8 cites an Altair MotionSolve tutorial coupling a tracked vehicle to EDEM.
facts.quote: Chapter 11 lists it as Simcenter EDEM; Chapter 8 cites an Altair MotionSolve tutorial that couples a tracked vehicle to EDEM

facts.text: Fraunhofer ITWM Demify is a research and service product for DEM-oriented soil-tool interaction in heavy machinery.
facts.quote: Fraunhofer ITWM Demify, DEM-oriented soil-tool interaction for heavy machinery, a research and service product

facts.text: Project Chrono provides SCM, CRM and DEM terrain models.
facts.quote: Project Chrono's terrain models (SCM, CRM and DEM)
